variables.input:
timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime), by: { cluster_name }
| fields cluster_name

timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }), by: { service }
| fields service

timeseries avg(aerospike_namespace_objects, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }), by: { ns }
| fields ns

0.content: **Latency View**: Latency percentiles. Not available in Dynatrace yet: each tile shows the equivalent Prometheus query. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

2.content:
### Percentiles $operation

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (histogram_quantile()). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
avg by (ns) (histogram_quantile(0.95, (aerospike_latencies_${operation}_${latencytimeunit}_bucket{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", service=~"$node"})))
avg by (ns) (histogram_quantile(0.99, (aerospike_latencies_${operation}_${latencytimeunit}_bucket{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", service=~"$node"})))
avg by (ns) (histogram_quantile(0.999, (aerospike_latencies_${operation}_${latencytimeunit}_bucket{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", service=~"$node"})))
```

3.content:
### Latency $operation

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (a heatmap panel). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
sum by (le) (aerospike_latencies_${operation}_${latencytimeunit}_bucket{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node"})
```
